preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
The number of rows and columns is between 2 and 10^3, inclusive.
The size of the consecutive elements to be modified is between 2 and the minimum of the number of rows or columns, inclusive.
The elements of matrices A and B are integers with absolute values up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: The sum of R over all test cases does not exceed 10^3
preconditions.description: The total number of rows across all test cases does not exceed 10^3.

preconditions.expression: The sum of C over all test cases does not exceed 10^3
preconditions.description: The total number of columns across all test cases does not exceed 10^3.

postconditions.description: The output must be a clear decision on whether matrix A can be transformed into matrix B using the given operations.
